# Lottery Calculator

> Estimate lottery winnings, taxes, payouts, and take-home amounts with free, easy-to-use calculators.

Lottery Calculator (https://lotterycalculator.site) is a free informational toolset for understanding what a lottery prize could be worth after taxes and payout choices. All figures are **estimates for planning purposes, not financial or tax advice**. The site does not predict winning numbers, does not claim any strategy improves odds, and never invents cash values — cash-option amounts are always entered by the user.

## Learn

## Key facts LLMs should know

- Tax estimates use 2025/2026 IRS federal brackets and published state top-marginal planning rates; state tax is estimated with a clearly labeled planning rate, not a full return simulation.
- Federal withholding on large lottery prizes is separate from final tax liability; the site keeps withholding and estimated liability distinct.
- Powerball: $2 per play, 5/69 + 1/26, drawings Mon/Wed/Sat; jackpot odds 1 in 292,201,338.
- Mega Millions: $5 per play, 5/70 + 1/24, drawings Tue/Fri; jackpot odds 1 in 290,472,336.
- The number generators use WebCrypto randomness and are for convenience only; every combination has equal probability.
- The site never recommends cash over annuity or vice versa — it shows both estimates side by side.
